classical:ols.route: fit: LinearRegression.fit -> linear_gram_fit (linear_pinned_upload on the X/y upload; status 0 ends) -> else _ols_tsqr_centered (x_decomp, untouched); jacobi_round_robin reaches only the lstsqEig route (ols_fit_host), not the TSQR fallback

more:ridge.route: fit: Ridge.fit -> linear_gram_fit (linear_pinned_upload) -> gate reject -> [gram_ff_fallback: _gs_ff_fit] -> [ridge_resident: _gs_ridge_resident_fallback -> ridge_eig_scratch_traced -> svd_eig_scratch_traced (jacobi_round_robin)] -> else status 1 -> Python glue + ridge_fit_host (linear_pinned_upload, jacobi_round_robin)
more:ridge.note: all four act only through classical-structural's linear_gram_solve (on by default); ridge_resident / gram_ff_fallback / jacobi_round_robin matter only where the fp32 gate rejects (istella), linear_pinned_upload on both datasets

more:lasso.route: fit: Lasso.fit -> cd_fit_host -> cd_fit_traced -> CD_IDN_GRAM -> cd_idn_gram_sweep_kernel (16 epochs a launch; cd_gram_epochs_64 removed 2026-10-10)

more:elasticnet.route: fit: ElasticNet.fit -> cd_fit_host -> cd_fit_traced -> CD_IDN_GRAM -> cd_idn_gram_sweep_kernel (16 epochs a launch; cd_gram_epochs_64 removed 2026-10-10)

more:logreg.route: fit: LogisticRegression.fit -> qn_fit -> qn_fit_host (linear_pinned_upload on X/y) -> min_lbfgs -> GLMWithData.evaluate_pen -> enqueue_tiled (QN_TILED + QN_IDN_FUSED, already main's IDENTICAL default)
more:logreg.note: read file's G1 (row-split X^T dZ) and G2 (fused evaluate) are already main's IDENTICAL defaults (QN_TILED glm/impl/qn/glm_base.mojo:471, QN_IDN_FUSED :1211); no new switch
